title: Gauss-Green identity for the complement with reversed normal
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, D, F ⊆ ℝ^P with F Borel, μ a measure on ℝ^P and ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Suppose ∫_F trace(Dφ) dL^P = −∫ ⟨φ, ν⟩ dμ for every C¹ map φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ D. Then ∫_{ℝ^P ∖ F} trace(Dφ) dL^P = −∫ ⟨φ, −ν⟩ dμ for every such φ. Here L^P = volume, the integrals are Bochner integrals, and ⟨·,·⟩ = inner ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet F → (∀ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → ∀ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in Fᶜ, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (-ν z) ∂μ
